title: Removes PayTo-specific fields from Payment Methods
summary: Removes the payto field (containing account_number, bsb_number, and pay_id) when you update PaymentMethods. Previously, the API accepted these PayTo-specific fields with a 200 status but never persisted the values. You can still update other fields such as billing_details and metadata for PayTo Payment Methods. The payto parameter isn’t accepted when you update a Payment Method. If your integration sends payto or any of its sub-fields (account_number, bsb_number, pay_id) when updating a PayTo Payment Method, the request returns an error instead of a 200 status. Update your code to remove these fields from your requests.

migrationNotes.text: If your integration passes payto, payto[account_number], payto[bsb_number], or payto[pay_id] to update a Payment Method, those requests now return an error. Remove these fields from your update calls. No previously stored data is affected because the API never persisted these values.

The `payto` parameter isn’t accepted when you [update a Payment Method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/update.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive). If your integration sends `payto` or any of its sub-fields (`account_number`, `bsb_number`, `pay_id`) when updating a PayTo Payment Method, the request returns an error instead of a `200` status. Update your code to remove these fields from your requests.
